title: Plant Release Standard: Releasing Entry & Patio Door Contract Orders to the Factory
content:
Under Entry & Patio Door Contracts, the confirmed door specifications of a contract are released to the factory once the contract is measured. Release creates the factory production order for the contract, recorded under Factory Production Orders, and moves the contract from measured to ordered.

## Release conditions

**Deposit.** The door order may be released only after the required booking deposit has been received in full. This is read from the payments recorded on the contract against its signed contract price.

**Cooling-off wait.** For an in-home sale, the door order may be released only once the cooling-off period counted from the contract signing date has fully passed. Business days are counted starting the day after the contract signing date, skipping Sundays and U.S. federal holidays, so Saturdays count as business days. Release on the last day of the cooling-off period is too early; the first permitted release date is the next calendar day. Showroom and virtual consultation sales carry no cooling-off wait.

The signing date and the sales channel are read from the contract record.

| Sales channel | Cooling-off wait before release |
|---|---|
| In-home | Yes: release from the calendar day after the last day of the cooling-off period |
| Showroom | None |
| Virtual consultation | None |

## Counting the wait (hypothetical in-home contracts, 3-business-day cooling-off period, no federal holiday in the span)

| Signed on | Business day 1 | Business day 2 | Business day 3 (last day) | Release on the last day | First permitted release date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Too early | Friday |
| Thursday | Friday | Saturday | Monday (Sunday is skipped) | Too early | Tuesday |

Where a U.S. federal holiday falls inside the count, that day is skipped like a Sunday, and the last day of the period moves to the next day that counts.

## Judgement table

| Measured | Required deposit received in full | In-home sale with the cooling-off period not yet fully passed | Order may be released |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Yes | No | Either | No |
